sources.entry: Zenphoto - Gallery and CMS project. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Zenphoto is a standalone PHP content management system for multimedia websites, centered on photo galleries with support for video and audio.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Zenphoto as a standalone CMS for multimedia-focused websites, aiming to be easy to use. It supports images, video and audio formats. The Zenpage CMS plugin adds a fully integrated news section (blog) and custom pages for running whole websites. The README points to separate pages for features, installation and upgrading, a support forum, bug reporting guidelines, and contributing. It does not list specific technical requirements in the README.
use_cases: host an artist or illustrator website
run a blog alongside a media gallery
showcase video and audio work for musicians or filmmakers
build a simple website with custom pages
how_to_run: See the Installation and upgrading page referenced in the README (no commands given in the README).
notable: Zenpage plugin adds a news/blog section and custom pages
Handles image, video and audio media
Aimed at ease of use with optional features kept out of the way
Designed for artists, photographers, designers and musicians
caveats: README gives no install commands or requirements; refers to external installation page
Security issues are directed to a contact page rather than public issues
